94d553fcfd9098256693581b2b107e8071a3ef30.README.md:
# links

Build the greenfield short link service: users create HTTP(S) links with optional aliases and expiry, resolve live codes, and inspect redirect counts. Unknown codes return 404. Do not add analytics beyond the supported link statistics.

Build the approved checkout with the Maven wrapper and `clean verify`.
